cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(PowerslaveVR CXX C)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")

set(TP ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party)

# MinHook (static)
file(GLOB MH_SRC ${TP}/minhook-master/src/*.c ${TP}/minhook-master/src/hde/*.c)
add_library(minhook STATIC ${MH_SRC})
target_include_directories(minhook PUBLIC ${TP}/minhook-master/include)

# def file forwarding exports generated by tools/gen_def.py
set(DEF_FILE ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdl2_forward.cpp)

add_library(SDL2 SHARED
    src/proxy/dllmain.cpp
    src/common/log.cpp
    src/common/config.cpp
    src/hooks/d3d_hooks.cpp
    src/hooks/audio_hooks.cpp
    src/xr/xr_session.cpp
    src/xr/xr_input.cpp
    src/input/virtual_pad.cpp
    src/render/stereo.cpp
    src/game/aim.cpp
    src/render/hand_weapon.cpp
    src/render/overlay.cpp
    src/render/blit.cpp
    src/render/gauges.cpp
    src/game/hud_state.cpp
    src/xr/fake_xr.cpp
    ${DEF_FILE}
)
target_include_directories(SDL2 PRIVATE src ${TP}/openxr/include)
target_compile_definitions(SDL2 PRIVATE XR_USE_GRAPHICS_API_D3D11 XR_USE_PLATFORM_WIN32 NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)
target_link_libraries(SDL2 PRIVATE minhook d3d11 dxgi ole32 d3dcompiler ${TP}/openxr/x64/lib/openxr_loader.lib)
set_target_properties(SDL2 PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME SDL2)

# header-only math unit tests (no game, no headset): build/pvr_tests.exe
add_executable(pvr_tests tests/test_math.cpp)
target_include_directories(pvr_tests PRIVATE src ${TP}/openxr/include)
